name: Canary Current
scope: OSW offshore reference corridor from a regional northern source gate near 35 N, past the western Canary archipelago, to a Cape Blanc offshore departure gate near 21 N. Excludes upstream Azores/Portugal routes, the broader Iberian-to-tropical Canary Current System, Lanzarote Passage recirculation, poleward undercurrents and downstream North Equatorial Current. No whole connected-system length.
layer: Upper-ocean southward return-flow naming context; source descriptions mention central waters over approximately upper 200-300 m. No depth-specific velocity core or uniform full-width footprint reconstructed.
time_convention: Regional circulation geography from 2018/2026 papers, with seasonal-path caveats from 2015 observations published in 2023. Selected offshore corridor is not a dated trajectory, annual mean axis or a particular seasonal route.
source_locator: Section 1 Introduction, first paragraph: distinguishes approximately 35-20 N named-current region from wider Canary Current System; bifurcation away from Africa near Cape Blanc (21 N) toward the North Equatorial Current.
source_citation: Kounta et al. (2018), A model perspective on the dynamics of the shadow zone of the eastern tropical North Atlantic - Part 1: the poleward slope currents along West Africa, Ocean Science 14, 971-997, doi:10.5194/os-14-971-2018.

supporting_sources.citation: Ibrahim and Sun (2026), A multidecadal sea level rise and its hiatus in the tropical Atlantic margin off northwest Africa, Ocean Science 22, 2059-2081, doi:10.5194/os-22-2059-2026.
supporting_sources.locator: Section 4 opening paragraphs: source-region convergence around 35 N and upper-layer context.
supporting_sources.role: Northern geographic naming-gate context; no model axis digitized.

supporting_sources.citation: Perez-Hernandez et al. (2023), The Seasonal Cycle of the Eastern Boundary Currents of the North Atlantic Subtropical Gyre, JGR Oceans 128, e2022JC019487.
supporting_sources.locator: Abstract and sections 1-2: regional seasonal migration and distinct Lanzarote Passage flow; Table 1 and prose disagree about fall cruise month.
supporting_sources.role: Seasonal continuity caveat; no 2015 observed axis, section width, transport or annual extrema reconstructed.

coordinate_selection: Every offshore vertex and endpoint is OSW-selected. The regional source names latitude ranges and departure geography, not these longitude gates or a current axis. A western archipelago detour avoids island-centre locations but is not identified as a measured fall path. Shorter northern/southern approach gates test naming convention. No source arrows, inverse-model fields or tracks digitized.

alternative_routes.interpretation: Selected shorter regional naming approaches, not measured seasonal contraction.

scenario_rule: Two selected feed-region/Cape Blanc gate conventions crossed with longitude and independent endpoint latitude offsets -0.05/0/+0.05 degrees: 54 editorial scenarios, not seasonal variation or confidence bounds.
method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed.
map_land_check: All 54 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
state_relation_role: Editorial line/display-region crossing; physical current passage unresolved.
